package main

import (
  "fmt"
  "os"
  "strings"
)

func main() {
  if len(os.Args) < 2 {
    os.Exit(2)
  }
  switch os.Args[1] {
  case "lsp-command-ids":
    fmt.Println(`["ttsc.fake.fix"]`)
  case "lsp-code-action-kinds":
    fmt.Println(`["source.fixAll.ttsc"]`)
  case "lsp-code-actions":
    fmt.Print(strings.Repeat("x", 6*1024*1024))
  default:
    fmt.Println(`[]`)
  }
}
